_comment: Shared mention-tokeniser contract (adversary round 2 #6, 2026-09-10): the SPA composer (Composer.tsx mentionTokens) and the board (board._mention_handles) must agree on which @handles a text addresses. `handles` are the registered handles; `expect` is the ordered list of handles the text mentions. Read by tests/test_mentions_contract.py and web/src/components/mentions.test.ts.
